Sensitivity: a change in the driving exposure (e.g. TIV, protection class, loss frequency) beyond the appetite threshold that flipped the decision is documented so the pivot point is explicit.

Materiality: only new information that materially changes the risk (e.g. loss ratio moving across a filed band, a hazard removed) justifies an overturn; immaterial changes uphold the original decline.
